g.text: Sequence Diagram - WEB06 Retrieve the Active Kitchen Configuration and load its assets (viewer contract 3.4.5)
WEB06 owns this endpoint, its JSON contract and the viewer contract (3.4.5).
VIS01 implements the viewer states and the rendering. The front end contains NO layout:
every scene comes from this answer (AC 7) and is shown only when complete (AC 8).

row would be a 500). It does NOT guarantee that the
file can be downloaded: files were checked at seed and
at activation, but the viewer still verifies them below.
